full_name: Liisa Holm | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Biological Sciences William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow University of Helsinki (Finland)
bio: Liisa Holm, a professor in the department of biological and environmental sciences at the University of Helsinki, has worked on structural bioinformatics and the evolutionary classification of proteins.
